description: Chellie Pingree is running to build an economy and health care system that works for everyday Mainers—not powerful corporations. She’s fighting to lower prescription drug costs, protect reproductive freedom, strengthen Social Security and Medicare, tackle climate change with clean energy jobs, and ensure working families can earn a livable wage.
